text:
Estimated before the meal: 
- Fruit bowl (cantaloupe and watermelon): about 200 g, 70 kcal.
- Cabbage salad with tofu: about 250 g, 330 kcal.
- Spring rolls (2): about 200 g, 300 kcal.
- Sushi (6 pieces): about 180 g, 270 kcal.
- Pickled ginger, wasabi and soy sauce: about 30 g, 15 kcal.
- Lemonade: about 300 g, 120 kcal. The water has no calories.

After the meal:
- Fruit: about 80% eaten (cantaloupe left, watermelon gone), so about 160 g and 56 kcal.
- Salad: about 70% eaten, with sauce and a few leftovers, so about 175 g and 230 kcal.
- Spring rolls: one eaten and one left, so about 100 g and 150 kcal.
- Sushi: 4 of 6 pieces eaten, so about 120 g and 180 kcal.
- Ginger and soy sauce: ginger eaten, soy partly used, so about 15 g and 8 kcal.
- Lemonade: about 10% drunk, so about 30 g and 12 kcal. The glass looks nearly full, so I count only a little.

Totals: kcal ≈ 56 + 230 + 150 + 180 + 8 + 12 = 636; mass ≈ 160 + 175 + 100 + 120 + 15 + 30 = 600 g.
